newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares set to fall on German EMU worries.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares set to fall on German EMU worries.

text.p: 0725 GMT - Dutch blue chips seen opening down as sentiment depressed by renewed fears Germany could fail to make its EMU targets on time, dealers say. Softer dollar and lower guilder bonds also set to undermine market.
* AEX closed up 2.16 points or 0.29 percent higher at
